41510003.name: Sentou Yousei Yukikaze: Yousei no Mau Sora
41510003.status_description: This title is playable, with minor issues.

report.gl_renderer: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (radeonsi, navi31, LLVM 20.1.6, DRM 3.63, 6.15.2-arch1-1)
report.compat_comments:
Played for about 20 minutes before stopping.

FMVs seem to run fine without any issue; no crashes or lagging.

In-game audio fails to play a lot of sounds including music and any voice acting. Instead, a static/crackling noise is present. SFX of weapons fire seems mostly intact.
Menus sometime play voice acting but not always (such as briefing before mission); music is always absent, instead the crackling noise is there. Button SFX seems to work fine.
See issue 904.

Graphics appear fine. Game runs at a steady 30FPS on both Vulkan and OpenGL, resolution scaling on or off.

It's technically playable, but the experience will be impacted negatively due to severe audio issues.

4541009F.status_description: This title is playable, with minor issues.

report.gl_renderer: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (radeonsi, navi31, LLVM 19.1.7, DRM 3.63, 6.15.2-arch1-1)
report.compat_comments:
Played two games.

FMVs & sounds are fine with no apparent issues.
On Vulkan, lag is severe and makes the game unplayable with certain camera angles (issue 1137). Drops to 30FPS regularly.
On OpenGL, game has significant improvements and is actually quite playable besides minor issues. There are frame drops sometimes, but they're only for a quarter of a second before going right back to 60. It's pretty unnoticeable in standard gameplay.
Resolution scaling with OpenGL seems to work fine and introduces no new issues.

Yard lines do not disappear based on where camera is, showing improvement.
Issue 2173 still occurs (shadow errors on both referee and players on night maps).

45530005.name: Deus Ex: Invisible War
45530005.status_description: This title is playable, with minor issues.

report.compat_comments:
==STATUS==
Playable, game is definitely able to be beaten as of current XEMU release (0.8.96) as of writing.

==ISSUES==
- Increasing the Resolution Scaling to above x1 will cause artifacts along the left and top of the screen. This is fixable by reducing the scaling to x1.
- Shadows have clipping errors, resulting in dynamic shadows not rendering correctly.
- Framerate in some areas are slightly lower than on actual hardware, in particular on first visit the Black Gate Ruins, Shackleton Ice Shelf, as well as the Order Mosque and Arcology Levels 107-108 on second visit are slightly worse in terms of FPS. This however isn't major in terms of breaking the game, as areas become less laggy once actors die.

4D570012.name: FireBlade
4D570012.status_description: This title starts, but may crash or have significant issues.

report.compat_comments:
Intro: The game has a cutscene at the main menu. This plays flawlessly with no issue. 

-----------------------

Sound: The game had no noticeable issues with sounds during my playtesting.

-----------------------

Performance and Gameplay: The game performed perfectly fine with no noticeable hiccups on my rig. There are some large scale battles with lots of enemies on screen during the first few missions. I didn't experience any noticeable slowdown, stuttering, or issues otherwise during these moments. 

Despite the good performance, two gameplay features are broken. Using thermal vision and using the speed boost both completely freeze the game's image until you disengage them. This makes these features unusable.

-----------------------

Graphics: No artifacting or issues otherwise were noticed. Interal upscaling also functioned perfectly fine without much issue

Overall, the reason this is given "Starts" and not "Playable" is because two fundamental features aren't usable.

5655000D.name: The Thing

report.compat_comments:
Overall, the entire game is very playable, up through the final cutscene.

There were dips in performance, but not too often and typically not major enough to severely impact gameplay.

The more problematic glitches observed include:
-Leaving xemu on in the background (est. 10-30 minutes) with this game running can lead to the game freezing, necessitating a restart via the xemu menus
-UI flickering, sometimes with UI elements being replaced with erroneous assets e.g. different parts of the targeting reticle replaced by machine gun icons
-Characters getting stuck along walls - unsticking without reloading/restarting can be hard
-Restarting a level can make the grenade launcher unusable - can fix by dropping exactly one launcher
-Game freezing/corrupt save files when saving in the Dome
-Bringing up a menu immediately as you are given control for the very last time during the last level may result in xemu becoming unresponsive, necessitating that the process be killed
